title: Beam across the hall
what: A wide side view of a whole hall: the followspot in its booth at the back, a long beam passing over seventeen rows of seated people, and the stage at the far end with a lectern, a mic stand, a speaker and a flown truss. Lights hang from the ceiling over the house.
why: This is the idea in one gesture: the light comes from the back, over everyone's heads, to land on one place on the stage. The distance covered by the beam is the sponsorship; the pool at the end is where you stand.
how: A shorter, wider SVG (612 by 460) with a long fan of five beam lines from the lens to a flat pool. The pointer anywhere across the hall slides the spot along the stage and the booth lamp tilts to follow; lines draw in on entry, reduced motion is static, and on mobile it becomes a compact strip above the header.
